maintenance._severity_weights_note: bias burst severity mix by × on dataset frequency; Hardware/Power have no Critical, so only Major/Minor/Warning are reachable

export._diurnal_note: optional 24-vector of relative network load by hour (Mon..Sun same curve); null = no modulation. Modulates per-episode UE mobility intensity (proxy for traffic) keyed to the episode anchor hour.
export._provenance_note: clear/ack delays are SYNTHESISED (the historical dataset has no cleared/acknowledged timestamps); per-severity log-normal in seconds, tunable below.
